summary: Duplicate promotional credit and negative VAT adjustment on EUR invoice after switching from hourly to reserved plan
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports two unexpected credits and a negative VAT adjustment on their March EUR invoice after they switched an org key from hourly hosted to a reserved dedicated pool on 2026-03-05. The invoice total does not match the expected amount shown in the Console billing preview and their accounting team flagged a negative tax line (-€18.42) combined with two separate promotional credits that appear identical.

Impact:
- Customer accounting blocked payment until discrepancy resolved (revenue hold).
- Customer cannot reconcile March accounting close.

Expected behavior:
- One promotional credit applied (promotion-id: PROMO-REDWOOD-NEWYEAR) and a VAT calculation that matches post-credit base.

Actual behavior:
- Two identical promo credits present as separate line items (both labeled PROMO-REDWOOD-NEWYEAR, same amount €150.00).
- VAT line shows a negative adjustment (-€18.42) which causes the invoice subtotal to be lower than the billing preview and sends total to negative provisional balance.

Relevant invoice IDs and timestamps:
- Invoice: INV-EU-2026-03-0151 (generated 2026-03-08)
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer switched key org:nordicai from hosted-hourly to dedicated-reserved (reservation id RES-667) on 2026-03-05.
2) Billing preview in Console showed expected invoice ~€1,150.
3) System generated final invoice INV-EU-2026-03-0151 on 2026-03-08.
4) Customer downloaded invoice PDF and GL export and observed two promo credit lines and an unexpected negative VAT adjustment.
5) Customer opened support ticket.

investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: double-application of the promo triggered by reservation transition webhook replay combined with tax recalculation path that applies VAT adjustments after credits are applied twice.
Queries run:
- Reviewed promo audit table: two separate promo_application rows exist for org:nordicai for the same promo_id with distinct application_ids (app-7b4 and app-9f1) but identical timestamps (02:14:24) - suggests a duplicate event processed concurrently.
- Checked ingestion chain: our reservation webhook was retried once due to transient 500 from pricing-service at 02:14:23 which may have caused a duplicate promo application job to be enqueued; queue dedupe should have dedup key but appears to have missed reservation->promo flow.
- Tax service: VAT recalculation logic flagged invoice as having credit change after initial tax calc, so it applied an adjustment in the opposite sign to correct rounding; combined with duplicate credits produced negative tax line.
Related dashboards and traces: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/billing/promo-applications?org=nordicai , trace: https://otel.redwood/trace/abc123
Preliminary severity: billing-impacting, revenue hold. Escalated to Billing Eng and Finance for release hold decisions.
resolution:
Temporary workaround applied 2026-03-11: Support created a manual credit reversal for the duplicated promo_application (application_id=app-9f1) and regenerated invoice as provisional INV-EU-2026-03-0151-R1. Finance accepted provisional invoice; customer released payment hold.
Longer term fix: Engineering to add stronger idempotency keys on the reservation->promo pipeline and move tax recalculation to a single-source-of-truth step after deduplication. PR submitted: github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/462 (pending review).
Follow-ups assigned: INT-1209 (billing dedupe work), link in linked_issues.
Customer notified 2026-03-12 via email with corrected invoice attached.
